R73 - PS4 venue LISTING contract with exact residuals, and the dependency evidence around a vault level (read-only; joins the
existing r7 vault decode (2026-09-19), the r7 arena-row join and the r68 directory listing (2026-09-22); no archive or DB is opened).

Coordinator review 2026-09-22 F3: exact counts, residual names, listing with provenance only; investigate consumer / dependency
evidence before any reassignment proposal. Per title:

  arena rows        every `exhibitionarena` row (arenaartid, arenaname, cityname) -> the vault levels whose `ID` equals arenaartid ->
                    per level name the shipped `rendering/stadiums/<name>/` directory (exact, lower-cased) -> one of
                    `unambiguous` (one level, one directory), `ambiguous_levels` (several levels share the id), `level_without_dir`,
                    `no_level` (no vault level carries the id);
  residuals         level ids shared by several names; level names without a directory; directories without a level name; arena
                    rows whose id is shared; levels with `ID != ArenaID`;
  dependencies      what a level record binds besides its name: `ArenaID`, `RinkId`, `CenterLogo`, `CenterLine`, `IceLine`
                    (numeric keys into the texpack sets - checked for membership), and the typed references it resolves
                    (`ge_crowdplacement`, `ge_nisoverridesgroup`, ...). A re-pointed arenaartid would change all of these at once;
                    this is the cascade a write contract would have to state. No runtime consumer is traced here.

Usage: python r73_ps4_venue_listing.py <out.json> [--titles nhl21]
